programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Somalia Pirates & Black Hawkdown"
programme.desc: On the 3 October 1993, an elite battle unit of the US army began a fairly straight-forward mission in Somalia’s capital Mogadishu. Within minutes of reaching their destination, the situation descended into chaos and the mission turned into a battle.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Paintball Guns, Ice Machines and Pool Tables"

programme.desc: Paintball gun, floor scrubber, ice machine, pool table, shopping trolley, gas boiler... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "AirVenture"
programme.desc: America’s largest aviation celebration.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Machu Picchu"
programme.desc: Stripping away the granite, CGI reveals the quake-proof walls and hidden canals that allowed Machu Picchu to survive at 11,000 feet.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Stripping Los Angeles to its core, CGI reveals the hidden steel and fault lines that help this earthquake-prone city survive "the Big One."

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: CGI peels back the Superdome and the city’s silt to reveal the massive pumps and barriers keeping New Orleans from sinking.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New York"
programme.desc: Dissecting New York's stone and steel, CGI reveals the inflatable subway plugs and bedrock foundations shielding the city from Atlantic superstorms.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Bridges: City Icons"
programme.desc: Here are ten of the world greatest modern bridges - engineering marvels and architectural masterpieces from around the world.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Adaptation"
programme.desc: Travel to La Paz, Bolivia, to see how high altitude impacts the body. From science to tradition, visit the witches market and learn about an ancient Inca medicine for altitude sickness

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Superfoods"
programme.desc: The high altitude environment makes foods that are considered "super". From quinoa, to special beans and salt - We travel from the Uyuni Salt flats back to La Paz to work with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Mother Earth"
programme.desc: Travel to the world's highest lake to see what is happening in this fragile ecosystem. We finish our Bolivian adventure with a ceremony honouring our planet.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "River Rescue"

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Minnesota Family Farmhouse"
programme.desc: A family in Minnesota hire a team of house truckers to move their historic farmstead closer to work to eliminate their daily commutes.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Million Dollar Mansion"
programme.desc: The Pilcher family in Saskatchewan call in a team of house truckers to haul their stunning mansion across rough fields and down narrow lanes to save it from being demolished.

programme.title: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: What fate awaits ships that were once proud vessels at bay, but have now turned into floating junkyards? While one option is to cut them up for scrap, another alternative is to use them to bolster marine biodiversity by turning them into artificial reefs. The old naval ships are sunk to an underwater resting place by ship sinkers.

programme.desc: There have been a few occasions when spacecraft have been lost in space. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at several of these adventures.
